add.note: 另见 is a written reference phrase meaning ‘see also.’ It points the reader to another entry or section, not to something visible.
见下文 is a compact written phrase meaning ‘see below / see the text below.’
见上文 means ‘see above / see the preceding text’ in written references.
参见附录 means ‘see/refer to the appendix.’ 参见 is used for consulting a written reference.
add.exampleEn: For details, please see the appendix.

patch.note: 越A越B = the more A, the more B. This is a core intermediate pattern; notice that both halves use 越.
即使…也… = even if…still/even then. Chinese normally keeps 也 in the result clause.
只要…就… = as long as/provided that…then. 只要 gives a sufficient condition; 就 gives the result.
看见 means physically notice/spot something with the eyes. It must not be used as a generic translation of English ‘see’ in references such as ‘see appendix’ or discourse uses such as ‘I see.’
